channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Producers turn Mardin into filming hub
item.description: The southeastern city of Mardin has become a magnet for domestic and international film and TV crews, with 70 productions applying to shoot there this year

item.title: Library on wheels travels 15,000 km to bring books to Kırklareli’s rural children
item.description: A mobile library serving the rural districts of the northwestern province of Kırklareli has traveled more than 15,000 kilometers in three years, bringing books and cultural activities to villages without access to a permanent library.

item.title: Daughter of Ankara terror attack victim beats cancer, takes pilot seat on THY visit
item.description: After recovering from cancer, the 10-year-old daughter of a Turkish aerospace engineer killed in a terrorist attack on Türkiye’s state-run aerospace company TUSAŞ, has visited Turkish Airlines (THY) and sat in the pilot’s seat, moving closer to fulfilling her dream of becoming a pilot.

item.title: Several top-tier players jailed pending trial in Turkish football betting probe
item.description: Türkiye’s widening football betting scandal intensified on Dec. 9 after an Istanbul court ordered the pre-trial detention of 20 suspects, including top-tier players, club presidents and referees.

item.title: Cypriot leaders hold second UN-sponsored meeting
item.description: Turkish Cypriot leader Tufan Erhürman and Greek Cypriot leader Nikos Christodoulides met for the second time under U.N.-sponsored talks on Dec. 11, signaling a step toward reviving long-stalled negotiations on the divided island.

item.title: Türkiye in second place on UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage List
item.description: Türkiye continues to rank second on UNESCO’s Intangible Cultural Heritage List, Professor Öcal Oğuz, president of the UNESCO Türkiye National Commission, has said, stressing that the country is “one of the most successful nations in the world” in this field.

item.title: Turkish travelers flock to Egypt as affordable prices, visa-free entry boost demand
item.description: As soaring domestic prices push holidaymakers toward more affordable, visa-free destinations, Egypt is rapidly emerging as a powerful magnet for Turkish travelers, a trend facilitated by lower costs, expanding flight options and the convenience of obtaining a visa on arrival at its Red Sea resorts.

item.title: Annual inflation to hit 20 pct range by early 2026, says Şimşek
item.description: Türkiye's annual inflation is expected to drop to the 20 percent range by February, when January figures are released, Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek said on Thursday.

item.title: Trump 'extremely frustrated' with Russia, Ukraine over talks on war
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump is "extremely frustrated" with Russia and Ukraine, his spokeswoman said on Thursday, as Kyiv said Washington was still pushing it to make major territorial concessions as part of its plan to end the nearly four-year war.

item.title: Israel's Syria actions delaying SDF deal with Damascus: Turkish FM
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan stated that Israel's heightened activities in Syria are prompting the YPG/PKK-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) to postpone fulfilling a March 10 agreement with the Syrian government.
